core_obligations: Reduce: syntomicness is \'etale local on source and target, so assume $B$ and $Y$ are affine schemes (proof lines 1046-1052).
Chart: $|X| \to |Y|$ is open, so choose an affine scheme $U$ \'etale over $X$ with $U \to Y$ surjective (proof lines 1052-1056).
Conclude $q$ (and $f$) syntomic by the scheme-side permanence lemma (proof lines 1056-1059).
proof_roadmap: Use \'etale locality to make $B$ and $Y$ affine.
Get a surjective \'etale affine chart of $X$ via openness.
difficulty_reason: Explicit \'etale reduction: syntomicness is \'etale local on $B$ and $Y$, so assume affine schemes; openness of $|X| \to |Y|$ yields an affine $U$ \'etale over $X$ mapping surjectively to $Y$; the scheme-side permanence lemma concludes (for both $q$ and $f$).
